text_block_list.text:
I'm walking through the halls on the way
back to
my office, when...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Uniqueness, uniqueness... Hmm. I've
thought
about it so much I'm starting to
get all confused.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэтангейзер

text_block_list.text: You're still on this uniqueness thing? I can't believe you.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah... No one's gonna remember a
normal
Umamusume like me.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэтангейзер

text_block_list.text:
Don't be like that... But if it's uniqueness
you
want, why not talk to her?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
And just like that, it came to me. Who
needs
stairs in this day and age when
you could have
slides?!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: Right! Time to do us some DIY!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text: Ooh! Now that is unique! I can really learn something here!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэтангейзер

text_block_list.text:
Wait, what—No! I was joking! Unique
doesn't
even cover it with her—she's
nuts!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Look closer! She's getting chased by Air
Groove!
And Эйр Грув looks reeeally
mad!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Wow... Her uniqueness really must be off
the
charts!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэтангейзер

text_block_list.text: Oh boy. She's completely off in her own world. Sigh... Guess I'll just have to lean into it...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Okay, listen. There's no way you can
measure up
to Golshi's prank level. She's
a regular prankster
queen.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
If you're gonna take inspiration from her,
I'd
suggest starting with some regular
pranks.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I can't do pranks, Nature. Pranks are
bad.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэтангейзер

text_block_list.text:
I appreciate the sensible answer. But
you're trying
to be like Golshi, right?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Oh! Y-you're right... But I don't want to
cause
trouble for anyone or damage
anything...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэтангейзер

text_block_list.text: Well, in that case, why don't you get some help from that person who's been listening in on us? ...That's okay with you, right?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Oh, will you really help?! Thank you so, so much!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэтангейзер

text_block_list.text:
Swept up by her enthusiasm, I find
myself going
along with
Матиканэтангейзер's pranks...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. I am the prankster
Матиканэтангейзер.
Now, let the
pranking commence!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэтангейзер

text_block_list.text:
Uh, would you mind closing your eyes?
I'm
planning to doodle on your face...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэтангейзер

text_block_list.text:
Aaand she's explaining the prank before
she does
it.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I'll just do this here and that there and...
Done!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэтангейзер

text_block_list.text:
Pfft... Drawing eyes on someone's
eyelids... a
classic... Pfft, ahahaha!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Whew! It turned out great!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэтангейзер

text_block_list.text:
Phew... What a riot. Hold on though...
Why did
you go all in like that? I mean,
look at all the
lashes you drew.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I used a water-based marker, so it'll
come off
easily. But just to be safe, be
sure to wash it off
soon, okay?
text_block_list.name: Матиканэтангейзер

text_block_list.text:
Thanks for helping me out! I think I
might just turn
into a prank master at
this rate!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэтангейзер

text_block_list.text: Yep, for sure.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Hm... wait. Does a single prank really
make me
any more unique?
text_block_list.name: Матиканэтангейзер

text_block_list.text:
It doesn't, right? I just asked someone if
I could
doodle on their face, then did it.
That's nothing!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэтангейзер

text_block_list.text:
Ahhh! I should have realized before I did
my
prank! This didn't help at all! I'm still
so normal!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэтангейзер

text_block_list.text:
Normal by your standards, maybe. But is
that
such a bad thing?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Huh?! You mean no matter what I do, I'll always just be boring, normal old me?!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэтангейзер

text_block_list.text:
But I've been trying sooo hard... Can't I
catch a
break, just once?
text_block_list.name: Матиканэтангейзер

text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... I think you're plenty interesting
juuust
the way you are.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Матиканэтангейзер might be a little
off-kilter,
but she's always
straightforward when it comes to

pursuing her goals.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
